meta.title: CTFPilot CTF solving tool
meta.description: Local dual-channel CTF solving engine as a DSH plugin: a deterministic fast path solves encoding chains, classical ciphers, XOR, archives and PNG LSB stego in seconds; misses fall through to the deep strategy loop. Includes experience recall, writeup learning, stats, a human-confirmed submit gate (propose → card → record), the CTFPilot solve form (pick 快解/深度解析, attach challenge folder, auto-injected mode brief sends a new dsh conversation under the unified CTF preset), a live solve-status board with real-time flag capture, and a CTF tool manager (health check + install/update/uninstall). Tool entry: /ctfpilot; sidebar icon opens the dashboard.
